title_sq: Ne Laprake, Tek Kompleksi Aura, Shitet Apartament 2+1 I Rregullt Ne Faze Perfundimtare!
description_sq: Ne Laprake, Tek Kompleksi Aura, Shitet Apartament 2+1 Me Super Planimetri!!! Apartamenti ka siperfaqe totale 116.9m² dhe siperfaqe neto 99.1m², ndodhet ne katin e trete banim te njeres prej godinave te kompleksit dhe organizohet nga korridori qe organizon ambientet, salloni i ndenjes me kendin e gatimit dhe ngrenies me dalje ne ballkon, dhoma matrimoniale me tualetin e vet, dhoma e dyte e gjumit qe akseson ne ballkon dhe tualeti i dyte ne korridor. Orientimi eshte Perendim. Kompleksi eshte i organizuar me dy kate parkimi nentoke, kati perdhe dedikuar totalisht ambienteve te biznesit dhe mbi te zhvillohen 10 kate banimi. Disa nga benefitet e kompleksit jane: fasade e veshur me termoizolim, sistem kapot ; dritare me dopio xham me mbushje me gaz per minimizimin e zhurmave dhe termoizolim; izolim akustik ne ndarjet ndermjet apartamenteve; sistem i pergatitur i ngrohjes qendrore. Oborri i brendshem eshte nje hapesire e plotesuar me stola dhe gjelberim, ne pjesen e pasme te kompleksit, pjesa veri-lindore e tij. Prona disponon dhe nje post parkimi ne -2 me cmim ekstra 26000Euro. (nuk eshte kusht per tu blere me apartamentin).
title_en: In Laprake, at Aura Complex, 2+1 Regular Apartment for Sale in the Final Phase!
description_en: In Laprake, Aura Complex, 2+1 Apartment For Sale With Super Floor Plan!!! The apartment has a total area of ​​116.9m² and a net area of ​​99.1m², it is located on the third residential floor of one of the buildings of the complex and is organized by the corridor that organizes the premises, the living room with the cooking and dining area with access to the balcony, the matrimonial room with its own toilet, the second bedroom that accesses the balcony and the second toilet in the corridor. Orientation is West. The complex is organized with two floors of underground parking, the ground floor is completely dedicated to business premises and 10 residential floors will be developed above. Some of the benefits of the complex are: facade covered with thermal insulation, capot system; double-glazed windows with gas filling for noise reduction and thermal insulation; acoustic insulation in the partitions between apartments; prepared central heating system. The inner courtyard is a space filled with benches and greenery, at the back of the complex, its north-eastern part. The property also has a parking space at -2 with an extra price of 26,000 Euros. (it is not a condition to buy with the apartment).
